thread: maddie: Quick design review for trace/request drilldown UI. Figma link: https://figma.redwood/app/drilldown-v5. Need alignment on: export placement, copy/correlation affordance, truncation strategy, and a11y for stacktrace rows. eli: Bulk export should be in the page toolbar (CSV default). Per-row exports are rare; keep them under per-row kebab menu. Copy-correlation needs to be 1-click and visible. tim: Copy button next to the ID is best. Make touch target >=44px. Use tooltip "Copy correlation id" and show "Copied!" transiently. Avoid making the ID itself the copy target on mobile. jyoti: Accessibility: icon-only buttons need aria-labels (e.g., "Copy correlation id"). Ensure focus order and visible focus ring. Use aria-live polite region to announce "Copied". If truncating visually, SR should read full id via aria-label. sara: Analytics: fire `correlation_copy` event with hashed id; debounce so repeated clicks don't spam. For copy failures, show an inline toast and announce to SR: "Copy failed". maddie: Truncation options: show first 8 chars + ellipsis in list, full id on hover/focus/tooltip and full display on drilldown. Copy must always copy full id. eli: Also add a permalink icon that opens the drilldown. Keyboard users should be able to open permalink with Enter. tim: Sample markup we can reuse: ``` abcdef12... ``` and an aria-live role="status" region for feedback. jyoti: Make sure color contrast >=4.5:1 for pill text/background. Focus ring 2px, visible color. Keyboard order: pill -> copy -> kebab. maddie: Recap decisions: 1) Toolbar bulk export (CSV default, JSONL option). 2) Per-row kebab includes "Export row". 3) Copy icon visible with aria-label + aria-live feedback. 4) Visual truncation in list, full via tooltip/aria-label/drilldown. 5) Ensure 44px touch targets, contrast, and keyboard flow. I'll update figma and open a PR with accessibility tests. ux-bot: Reminder: attach keyboard walkthrough and contrast report to PR checklist due Friday. :spiral_calendar:
